configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: Baseline for every host. clang 22 is required for the clang implementation family (tsl::clang_v*), whose profile header needs __builtin_elementwise_clzg. The compiler is pinned by name; the actual requirement is clang 22 or newer, so on a host with only a later one override both CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER and CMAKE_C_COMPILER, or use run_all.sh which discovers them.

configurePresets.name: dsa
configurePresets.description: For a host with DSA. DML is fetched and built in-tree; both compilers are pinned because DML enables the C language and would otherwise take whatever CC names. Needs uuid-dev for DML's hardware dispatcher. Set DML_ROOT to consume a pre-built DML instead.

configurePresets.name: iaa
configurePresets.description: For a host with IAA. Expects test-sort/iaa_run_detector.hpp to provide TslIaaRunDetector<T> and TslIaaAsyncRunDetector<T>; the contract is documented in benchmarks/cosort_detectors.hpp.

configurePresets.name: gcc
configurePresets.description: Kept because the clang implementation family is unavailable here, so a GCC build measures only the intrinsic styles.
